subject: Settle path & timing — virtual-card onramp, escrow option, and UK VAT handoff
content:
Message 1 (2025-06-12 09:15 PDT)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Simon Kelly <simon.kelly@helioworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Settle path & timing — virtual-card onramp, escrow option, and UK VAT handoff

Hi Simon,

Following up on Invoice #5521 (due 6/18). Wanted to confirm HelioWorks' preferred settle path so we can avoid the end-of-week scramble. Options we can accept and the approximate timing: 

- Virtual card (single payment): authorizes immediately, typically posts within 2 business days on our side.
- ACH / bank transfer (SEPA or wire): we clear funds on receipt — wire confirmation speeds reconciliation.
- Split: partial escrow (Redwood holds 30%) + remainder on release (we can accept a DocuSign-backed split if AP prefers).

We also flagged the VAT documentation — I attached your VAT cert we received yesterday. If the cert is current, we can zero-rate the invoice for UK VAT on our reconciliation. If not, we need the updated form before settlement to avoid re-invoicing.

If virtual card is easiest, I can send the onboarding link and a quick note to your AP to get the card details in place. If wire, please confirm bank cutoff for Friday (we're on PT; if you wire by EOD UK time Friday we should post before Monday).

Attached: Invoice_5521.pdf, HelioWorks_VAT_cert.pdf

Ask: Can you confirm preferred path and the name/email of the AP contact who will send payment or authorize the virtual card?

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Payments Ops | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Great — thanks Simon. Quick operational notes from my side so AP has everything: 

- Wire details: Redwood Bank (US) / Redwood EU ops — please include Invoice 5521 in the payment reference. If HelioWorks needs beneficiary IBAN/Swift for GBP/EUR, ping me and I'll send the exact account.
- Cutoff: For funds to be visible on our ledger before the 18th, please send wire by Friday 3:00 PM BST (which is 07:00 PDT for us).
- Reconciliation: Once AP sends the wire receipt, reply-all with the confirmation number and we will mark the invoice cleared.

If you instead decide virtual card at the last minute, we can accept that too — virtual-card processing will post slightly faster but requires AP to accept a tokenized expense flow. If helpful, Mina can send the VC onboarding link now.

Cc'ing Marissa for collections visibility and to make sure the invoice is staged correctly in charging.

Thanks,
Priyom

Hi Simon / AP Team — quick nudge. We haven't received the wire confirmation yet and today is the stated target. Can you confirm status or share a payment trace? If there's a delay and you'd like to switch to virtual card, I can spin up the tokenized payment link (takes ~15 minutes for AP acceptance).

If AP prefers a split (30% escrow / 70% immediate), we can accept a two-part settlement and will issue a short DocuSign for the escrow terms — happy to draft if helpful.

If you already sent the wire, please reply with the transaction reference and the last four of the sending account so we can reconcile immediately.

Thanks for the quick turn,

Mina Haddad
Senior Payments Ops | Redwood Inference
